Annotated clinic — declared entity types, styled apart

A clinic where ordinary patients and VIPs queue together but are drawn apart.

What to watch for

Blue circles are ordinary patients, red triangles are VIPs. The application knew both classes existed before the model was ever run — they are declared with entityType and the processes carry an annotation — so they appeared in the styling list ready to be given a look, rather than being discovered from a trace after the fact.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (8 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
